inference: Match whole Latin words or exact contiguous script text, longest nonoverlapping first.
Split explicit conditions by punctuation or a conjunction only when both sides have a distinct action. Preserve offsets into original text.
Prefer an exact public object name and literal identity; same-label multiple objects are unresolved.
No pronoun-to-target guess without one explicit antecedent in the same clause.
Keep/unchanged and an explicit forbidden edit can express the same preservation condition; permission makes no guarantee.
Treat one and all as sets only where the shared input names the members or the official clause quantifies them.
A qualifier without an action or target does not create a positive assertion. Unknown or conflicting version never certifies.
